body:
## Pull request overview

This PR standardizes Gallery and Timeline spec config integration across ObjectUI by replacing legacy flat prop spreading with nested config objects and strong types from `@objectstack/spec/ui`. It fixes a bug where `ListView.tsx` was spreading config flat instead of passing nested objects, causing spec properties like `cardSize`, `coverFit`, and `visibleFields` to be lost for Gallery, and timeline config to not propagate correctly to ObjectTimeline.

**Changes:**
- Introduced `ListViewGalleryConfig` and `ListViewTimelineConfig` intersection types combining spec-canonical types with legacy fields for backward compatibility
- Refactored `ListView.tsx` to pass gallery and timeline configs as nested objects instead of flat spreads
- Updated `ObjectTimeline` to accept and prioritize nested `schema.timeline.*` config with proper fallback chains
- Added comprehensive test coverage (35 new tests across gallery, timeline, and type validation)

### Reviewed changes

Copilot reviewed 8 out of 8 changed files in this pull request and generated 3 comments.

<details>
<summary>Show a summary per file</summary>

| File | Description |
| ---- | ----------- |
| `packages/types/src/objectql.ts` | Defines `ListViewGalleryConfig` and `ListViewTimelineConfig` intersection types extending spec types with legacy fields and index signatures |
| `packages/types/src/index.ts` | Exports the new `ListViewGalleryConfig` and `ListViewTimelineConfig` types |
| `packages/react/src/spec-bridge/bridges/list-view.ts` | Updates spec bridge from `any` to strong `ListViewGalleryConfig`/`ListViewTimelineConfig` types |
| `packages/plugin-list/src/ListView.tsx` | Refactors gallery and timeline cases to merge spec config over legacy options and pass as nested objects with deprecated flat prop fallbacks |
| `packages/plugin-list/src/__tests__/ObjectGallery.test.tsx` | Adds 12 spec config integration tests covering coverField, cardSize, coverFit, visibleFields, titleField, and legacy fallbacks |
| `packages/plugin-list/src/__tests__/GalleryTimelineSpecConfig.test.tsx` | Adds 10 type-level tests validating ListViewSchema accepts spec config, legacy fields, and co-existence scenarios |
| `packages/plugin-timeline/src/ObjectTimeline.tsx` | Implements nested timeline config support with fallback chain: `timeline.*` → `mapping.*` → flat props → defaults |
| `packages/plugin-timeline/src/__tests__/ObjectTimeline.spec-config.test.tsx` | Adds 13 spec config tests for startDateField, endDateField, groupByField, colorField, scale, and backward compatibility |
</details>

According to Rule #-1 (English-Only Codebase), all user-facing text in comments, documentation, and code MUST be written in English for international accessibility. The PR title and issue description contain Chinese text ("标准化接入"), which should be translated to English. While this is a critical codebase convention, the actual code implementation here is correct and properly documented in English.

According to Rule #2 (Documentation Driven Development), any feature implemented or refactored MUST update corresponding documentation. This PR standardizes Gallery/Timeline config integration but does not update:

1. `packages/plugin-list/README.md` - Should document the new spec-compliant `gallery` and `timeline` fields in the schema examples and add migration guidance from `options.gallery`/`options.timeline` to the new nested config pattern.
2. `packages/plugin-timeline/README.md` - Should document the new `timeline.*` nested config support with field examples (startDateField, endDateField, scale, etc.).
3. `content/docs/plugins/plugin-timeline.mdx` - Should show examples of using ObjectTimeline with the spec-compliant nested config.

The definition of done requires that documentation reflect the new code/architecture. Users reading the documentation will not discover the new nested config pattern without these updates.

According to Guideline 1000001, after completing a development task, tests should be run and any issues addressed. The PR description mentions comprehensive test coverage (12 ObjectGallery tests, 13 ObjectTimeline tests, 10 type-level tests, 70 bridge tests), but does not provide evidence of running `pnpm test` to verify all tests pass. Please run `pnpm test` (or `pnpm vitest run packages/plugin-list packages/plugin-timeline packages/types packages/react`) and confirm all tests pass before merging.
